<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Falcon Swoop](/Feats.aspx?ID=5535) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 83

**Archetype** [Winged Warrior](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=227)

**Prerequisites**
[Winged Warrior Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5527)

**Requirements**
You currently have a fly Speed.

</column>

---

Like the fastest of predatory birds, you soar toward your prey at great speeds. [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) twice. At any point during this movement, you can make a Strike against one enemy within reach or within the first range increment of a ranged weapon. That enemy is [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) against the Strike if you're attacking them from above.
name: Falcon Swoop
requirement: You currently have a fly Speed.
